summary: Verified the enrollment-page Razorpay payment fix. Fresh signup → /enroll/:courseId → button correctly reads 'Pay ₹1,500 & Start My Journey' (not the old 'Start My Journey'). Clicking it: shows 'Opening payment…', calls POST /api/payments/create-order, loads checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js, and opens the REAL Razorpay iframe (api.razorpay.com/v1/checkout/public) using test key rzp_test_TVeabM7YAvLTQs with the 'Test Mode' banner clearly visible. Critically, the user is NOT redirected to /dashboard on click — the free-enroll bypass is gone. Actual card-entry-through-to-dashboard was not automated (Razorpay's cross-origin iframe + OTP flow is fragile to script), but the payment-first invariant that the fix promised is fully proven end-to-end up to the checkout iframe render.

rca of the issue: Original bug: EnrollmentPage.jsx called enrollDirect() directly from the CTA onClick, bypassing payments entirely. Fix: introduced handlePayAndStart() which calls usePaymentFlow.startPayment('upfront'); the pre-existing enrollDirect logic (handleStart) is now passed as the onSuccess callback so it only fires after server-side signature verification. Button label + fineprint updated to make the payment step user-visible. Verified live: button shows 'Opening payment…' and the real Razorpay test-mode iframe opens; no /dashboard redirect on click.
